label: Hugging Face
description: Models, datasets and spaces of the Hub
agentGuide: The Hub API, base https://huggingface.co. Me: GET /api/whoami-v2. Search models: GET /api/models?search=<words>&sort=downloads&limit=10&filter=text-generation (id, downloads, likes, pipeline_tag); one: GET /api/models/<org>/<name> (card data, siblings = files). Datasets: GET /api/datasets?search=...; spaces: GET /api/spaces?search=.... A file of a repo: GET /<org>/<name>/resolve/main/<path> (README.md, config.json; big weights: do not). Collections: GET /api/collections?owner=<me>. Inference (text generation, images) runs on router.huggingface.co, another host this service does not reach: use OpenAI, Mistral or OpenRouter for that, or the generic API entry with the same token. The token is set by Allkin.
